name: claude-cycling-mcp
description: Describe a structured cycling session once; render it to a MyWhoosh .zwo and a Garmin Connect workout.
long_description:
Writing a structured bike session means either clicking blocks around in a graphical editor or hand-writing XML — and the two platforms want different formats, so the same session gets built twice.

This server takes one flat, hand-editable workout spec and emits both files. Power is written in watts or % FTP; steady blocks, ramps, free rides and repeated sets are all supported, along with per-block cadence and on-screen messages.

**Pure and offline.** Every tool is deterministic: no network calls, no credentials, no uploads. `describe_spec` returns a block table with computed watts and estimated IF/TSS so a session can be checked before it is rendered, and `verify_garmin_upload` compares an uploaded workout against what was actually sent.

**Uploading lives in the bundled skills**, because it needs auth, a browser, and a human in the loop — a MyWhoosh export spends a finite slot credit. The skills ship as MCP prompts, so they are available from the prompt menu as soon as the server is connected.

tools.name: validate_spec
tools.description: Check a workout spec and report every problem found

tools.name: describe_spec
tools.description: Show the session as a block table with computed watts, duration, IF and TSS

tools.name: render_zwo
tools.description: Render the spec to a MyWhoosh-compatible .zwo file

tools.name: render_garmin
tools.description: Render the spec to a Garmin Connect workout payload

tools.name: check_garmin_payload
tools.description: Check a composed payload against the digest render_garmin issued, before uploading

tools.name: verify_garmin_upload
tools.description: Compare an uploaded Garmin workout against the payload that was sent

tools.name: verify_mywhoosh_import
tools.description: Check a MyWhoosh builder header against the session that was rendered, before export spends a credit

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Identify this server: version, where it is loaded from, and what it serves

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Fetch a bundled upload procedure by name

tools.name: spec_schema
tools.description: Return the workout spec's JSON schema and authoring notes

prompts.name: garmin-upload
prompts.description: Build a cycling workout and put it on Garmin Connect, verifying the result
prompts.text: Follow the "garmin-upload" procedure, using this server's tools. The full instructions are served by the server at run time; the session to build is ${arguments.session}.

prompts.name: mywhoosh-upload
prompts.description: Build a cycling workout and import it into MyWhoosh through the browser
prompts.text: Follow the "mywhoosh-upload" procedure, using this server's tools. The full instructions are served by the server at run time; the session to build is ${arguments.session}.
